metadata.title: Five assembly changes (11–15)
metadata.compiler: GCC13.2 explicit Spack mpicxx; Release/PETSc/deal.II9.8; effective O2/core-avx2
metadata.derivative_claim: None; derivative-Jacobian values are cached and near the timer floor.

physical_validation.scope: Fresh both archives, native analytic/CSV MPI1/MPI2; unchanged physical inputs and scalar IDA controls

limitations: One-node assembly timings and short physical regressions; no full-solver speed claim. All cumulative speedups come from this direct baseline/final experiment. Individual-step ADAN56 Jacobian decreases remain disclosed in intervention 15. Component TimerOutput scopes are rounded diagnostics, not independent samples or a complete accounting of the slowest-rank benchmark time. All ranges and slower pairs remain included.
